semantic_identity_policy: semantic order/cardinality/support topology defines legal identity layouts before geometry scoring
occlusion_semantics: OCCLUDED requires a non-empty current partial instance; zero current points are abnormal and are never normal occlusion
identity_safety_policy: UNCERTAIN/ABNORMAL is preferred over committing a wrong Global ID
motion_policy: X motion uses normal/hard envelopes; when L2 is active, L1 is a locked foundation and significant L1 motion is a structural abnormality
topdown_support: TOP_DOWN_Z uses global XY z-buffer along world -Z; matcher detects top-only observations from XYZ and restores geometric center Z using stable radius
double_layer_policy: L2 may activate only after L1 has 10 slots; upper slot k is supported by L1 slots k and k+1; support topology is primary L2 identity evidence
double_layer_bootstrap: If startup already contains L2, bootstrap 10 L1 foundation slots plus visible L2 support slots; every physical coil still requires positive point evidence or remains UNCERTAIN
